description: Cycle paths (自行車道) of a city: name, district, the roads where each starts and ends, length and its end points; near a coordinate (nearest first) or by a keyword in the name, road or district. Example: city "Taipei", keyword "河濱"; or lat 25.0478, lon 121.517, city "Taipei".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, Chiayi, ChiayiCounty, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, 高雄市, ...).

keyword.description: Part of the path name, a road or a district, e.g. "河濱", "信義區".

limit.description: Maximum number of cycle paths to return (default 10).

name: cycling_routes
title: Cycle paths
